messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • Prod inference latency/errors detected on route text-gen-prod
ops-bot: metrics: 5xx spike to 11%, p95 latency 3.9s, KV cache miss rate climbed 78% from baseline ~7% in 10m
ops-bot: Pager -> @oncall_alice

oncall_alice: taking pager, joining dashboards https://console.redwood.ai/d/rt/runtime-overview
oncall_alice: seeing a deploy around 2024-11-09T21:14Z - quantized model variant quant-v2 promoted to prod

sre_ben: if quant variant is the culprit, consider traffic split to stable and scaling nodes; avoid full rollback if we can mitigate

oncall_alice: applying mitigations: 1) shift 60% traffic to stable 2) spin up extra nodes with larger KV memory 3) temporarily increase KV TTL and disable async compaction
oncall_alice: executing route update:
```
POST /routes/text-gen-prod/actions
{ "split": { "stable": 60, "quant-v2": 40 } }
```

eng_runtime_carla: I'll prepare rollback if split doesn't bring p95 under 400ms in 3m

customer_success_erin: alerted CS. customers report streaming failures, any ETA for fix?

oncall_alice: estimate 5-12m for mitigation rollout across edges

ops-bot: Route change accepted. Edge propagation TTL ~15s

(4m later)
oncall_alice: route changes propagated. p95 down to 640ms, 5xx to 2.2% - improving

sre_ben: what's KV miss after shift?

eng_runtime_carla: KV miss fell to 26%. Root cause appears to be quant-v2's tokenization differences combined with a shorter kv_ttl and an async compaction change in the recent release, causing high churn and OOM evictions

oncall_alice: provisioning an instance group with doubled KV cache to stabilize while we patch configs

eng_runtime_carla: opening PR to bump kv_ttl for quant-v2 from 600s -> 3600s and disable ff/kv-async-compact in prod. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/kv-config/pulls/347

prod_manager_dan: let's schedule a post-incident review. who will own the writeup?

eng_runtime_carla: I'll draft the postmortem and own RCA and remediation. estimate full RCA + tests in ~48h

sre_ben: I'll own pipeline gating changes to require KV miss and OOM checks before auto-promote. will open change request

oncall_alice: current status: stable but still slightly degraded. p95 210ms, 5xx 0.35%. suppressing noisy alerts, CS notified

customer_success_erin: reached out to affected customers with a short note and workaround (use stable route), no escalations yet

ops-bot: REMEDIATION TICKET CREATED • #INC-2024-789

sre_ben: action items logged:
- eng_runtime_carla: PR for kv_ttl increase + compaction toggle - due 2024-11-12
- sre_ben: add canary gating for KV miss & OOM - due 2024-11-15
- oncall_alice: run mem calibration & capacity test for quant variants - due 2024-11-11
- prod_manager_dan: schedule postmortem meeting w/ eng-runtime, eng-sre, oncall, cs - proposed 2024-11-13 15:00 UTC
- eng_runtime_carla: add synthetic CI load test for quant tokenization patterns - due 2024-11-20

oncall_alice: preliminary root cause: quant-v2's tokenization pattern + kv_ttl/compaction changes -> excessive KV churn -> high miss -> latency spike and OOMs -> 5xx on streaming paths. auto-promotion happened before KV stability verified

eng_runtime_carla: logs during spike:
```
[2024-11-09T21:16:02Z] runtime: kv_miss=0.81 keys_in_cache=118k lookups=620k
[2024-11-09T21:16:05Z] runtime: eviction triggered memory_pressure=0.94 node=rt-05
[2024-11-09T21:16:07Z] grpc: stream error code=13 message="backend OOM"
```

sre_ben: note: ff/kv-async-compact was toggled on last week - rolling that flag back for prod

eng_runtime_carla: rolled flag off across prod groups. monitoring trends

(22m later)
oncall_alice: system stable. creating the incident timeline + summary in #INC-2024-789

prod_manager_dan: postmortem scheduled. agenda: timeline, root cause, why promotion gating failed, remediation, owners + deadlines

customer_success_erin: preparing customer-facing summary to send after postmortem sign-off

sre_ben: long-term proposals: cohort-based canaries, KV telemetry for tokenization distributions, automated rollback on OOM conditions

eng_runtime_carla: creating backlog tickets:
- KRT-1284 kv_ttl tuning for quant models -> owner carla -> due 2024-11-18
- KRT-1285 deploy gating for mem/kv thresholds -> owner ben -> due 2024-11-15
- KRT-1286 synthetic quant tokenization tests -> owner carla -> due 2024-11-20

oncall_alice: if residual errors surface ping this thread or @oncall for immediate handoff

eng_runtime_carla: uploading draft postmortem to the ticket and will tag reviewers

customer_success_erin: :thumbsup: holding customer outreach until postmortem approved

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • note: mitigations applied (route split, kv config, flag rollback). update ticket with postmortem link when ready.
